info.title: PoYo AI - Nano Banana 2 API
info.description: The Nano Banana 2 API generates or edits images with Gemini 3.1 Flash Image. It supports up to 14 reference images and output from 0.5K through 4K, including native 2K and 4K.

post.summary: Submit Nano Banana 2 / Nano Banana 2 Official Generation Task
post.description: Image generation and editing for both Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview and Fal official Nano Banana 2 model families

input.prompt: A cyberpunk street scene with neon signs and rain
Add colorful flowers in the foreground
A product hero shot of a transparent glass perfume bottle on reflective stone, soft daylight, premium editorial composition
Replace the background with a clean studio gradient and keep the product label sharp

BearerAuth.description:
All API endpoints require Bearer Token authentication.

Create an API key: sign in to PoYo, open **Dashboard → API Key** at [poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key](https://poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key), and click to create a key.

Add it to the request header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

callback_url.description: Webhook callback URL for result notifications

input.description: Input parameters for generation. Supported fields vary by model family.

prompt.description: Generation prompt describing the desired output
prompt.example: A beautiful sunset over the ocean

image_urls.description: Reference image URLs. Required for edit models and supports up to 14 images.

size.description: Image size ratio. `nano-banana-2-new` supports standard aspect ratios. `nano-banana-2-official` also supports `auto`, `4:1`, `1:4`, `8:1`, and `1:8`.

resolution.description: Output image resolution. `nano-banana-2-new` supports `1K`, `2K`, `4K`. `nano-banana-2-official` also supports `0.5K`.

output_format.description: Nano Banana 2 Official only. Output image format.

google_search.description: Use Google Web Search grounding to generate images based on real-time information. Supported by both model families; official models map it internally to `enable_web_search`.

seed.description: Nano Banana 2 Official only. Optional random seed for reproducible output.

code.description:
Business status code. `200` means success; any other value means the request failed. Always check this field: some validation errors return HTTP 200 with `code: 400` in the body.

- `200`: Success
- `400`: Invalid request parameters
- `401`: Missing or invalid API key
- `402`: Insufficient credits
- `403`: Permission denied
- `404`: Resource not found
- `408`: Request timeout
- `429`: Rate limit exceeded
- `500`: Internal server error
- `502`: Upstream service error
- `503`: Service unavailable

See [Error Codes](/api-manual/error-codes) for details.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier for status tracking

status.description:
Task status. Always `not_started` right after submission. Use [Query Task Status](/api-manual/task-management/status) or `callback_url` to get later states.

- `not_started`: Queued, waiting to be processed
- `running`: Being generated
- `finished`: Completed; results are in `files` or `output`
- `failed`: Failed; details are in `error_message`

created_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task was created
